artist.name: Gracie Abrams
artist.short_description: Gracie Abrams is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Gracie Abrams is an American singer-songwriter whose intimate writing has made her an important reference point for contemporary confessional pop. Her early releases, including the minor EP and This Is What It Feels Like, led into her debut album Good Riddance in 2023. The Secret of Us followed in 2024 and brought a broader, more rhythmically direct approach while retaining her close-up emotional narratives. The album featured a collaboration with Taylor Swift on 'us.' and included songs such as 'Risk,' 'Close To You' and 'I Love You, I'm Sorry.' In interviews and the Song Exploder discussion of 'I Love You, I'm Sorry,' Abrams describes how writing with trusted collaborators helped her place complicated emotions into a song. Her 2026 album Daughter from Hell belongs to the later catalogue and should not be conflated with the release chronology of the older songs. For Afterglow, the editorial connection is her ability to make shame, affection, memory and incomplete closure feel conversational. Those are broad editorial observations, not a claim that every chosen track is autobiographical; each song-specific claim needs its own evidence.
